'''Vigro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]-repairman who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He owned the [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] repair shop [[Vigro's Repulsorlifts]], which was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]].<ref name="A Wretched Hive" />

==Personality and traits==
A paranoid individual, Vigro had a mistrust of outsiders and was convinced that his customers were all trying to swindle him.<ref name="A Wretched Hive" />
